Assert nothing about model prose. If a journey reveals a real engine defect, do NOT fix storygame code: mark that single test with pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason=<one sentence>) and describe the defect precisely in the notes, so the orchestrator can decide.

OWNED FILES: tests/test_phase1_slice_playthroughs.py only (plus a new tests/helpers file only if an existing helper cannot be reused; say so in the notes). Do not edit storygame/** or data/**.

Focused: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_phase1_slice_playthroughs.py. Ruff on files you touch: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix <files>, then -m ruff format <files>. Do not run uv.
